name: Population
desc: $MarketName is home to hundreds of billions of people. Its cities ran into each other long ago, and the arcologies that hold them now reach the upper atmosphere.

name: Population
desc: A trillion souls live on $marketName, more than Old Earth ever held.

name: Population
desc: $MarketName houses tens of trillions. Every surface is filled with concrete, and the city goes as far down as it goes up.

name: Population
desc: Hundreds of trillions live on $marketName. People that are born here will never see nature.

name: Population
desc: $MarketName holds a quadrillion lives. The Omega core that runs it is the only mind in the Sector that can keep everyone from endless warfare.

name: Arcology World
desc: Arcologies kilometres tall have swallowed $marketName's old cities whole. What land is left between them is kept as parkland, because nothing else is needed there.

name: Ecumenopolis
desc: $MarketName is a single city from pole to pole. Its oceans run through pipes, its weather is scheduled, and its sky is lit all night by its own streets.

name: Hyper-Ecumenopolis
desc: An orbital ring circles $marketName, carried on its own spin and tied to the surface by hundreds of space elevators. Its docks and shipyards run the whole way round, and from below it cuts the sky in two.

name: AI Core Admin (hidden)
desc: Hidden condition to track when the core becomes un-removable. Does not need an icon.
